# Nathan Binomugisha - Freelance Video Editing & Post-Production Services

> Professional freelance video editing, color grading, and digital storytelling services for content creators, brands, and documentary filmmakers worldwide.

## About Nathan Binomugisha
- **Role**: Professional Freelance Video Editor, Colorist, & Digital Storyteller
- **Experience**: 10+ years in post-production, documentary editing, and YouTube audience retention optimization
- **Software**: DaVinci Resolve Studio Certified, Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects

## Core Services & Pricing
- **Short-Form Impact Edit ($163.55 USD)**:
  - Formats: YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, TikTok
  - Length: Up to 180 seconds
  - Features: Fast-paced retention editing, animated captions, motion graphics, sound design, color grading, 2 revision rounds.
  - Turnaround: 48 hours
  - Order: Available via Selar or direct inquiry
- **Long-Form Narrative Edit ($285.00 USD)**:
  - Formats: YouTube videos, docu-series, podcasts, educational films
  - Length: 10 to 25 minutes
  - Features: Retention-focused narrative structure, B-roll selection, sound mixing, color grading, 2 revision rounds.
  - Turnaround: 5-7 business days
  - Payment: Secure escrow / milestone invoice via Payoneer
- **Custom Premium Projects (Custom Quote)**:
  - Formats: Feature documentaries, brand commercials, complex multi-cam productions, visual effects (VFX).
  - Features: Customized deliverables, dedicated workflow, rush turnaround options.

## Post-Production Workflow
1. **Consultation & Creative Brief**: Strategy alignment, project objectives, style reference, and audience retention targets.
2. **Footage Transfer & Secure Invoicing**: Asset transfer via Google Drive / Dropbox / Frame.io; secure payment processing via Payoneer or Selar.
3. **Rough Cut to Fine Polish**: Narrative assembly, sound design, pacing optimization, and DaVinci Resolve color grading.
4. **Review & Delivery**: Client feedback incorporation across 2 revision rounds; delivery of high-bitrate master files.
